caption: The drawing depicts a powder horn, rendered in shades of brown and beige, against a plain, off-white background. The horn is curved and tapers towards a narrow, grooved spout at the top, with a wider, darker-colored base fitted with a metal or wooden cap. The surface of the horn is decorated with engraved or etched designs: at the upper section, there is a depiction of a unicorn. Below the unicorn, there is a series of smaller human figures, some seemingly holding weapons, as well as horses and a cart with a large spoked wheel. The details of the engravings are executed in a darker brown hue, contrasting with the lighter color of the horn. The composition centers the powder horn on the page, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Powder Horn
